verdict: No remaining static blocker found within the intended already-started R30 closure scope.
scope_reviewed: Full check_bindings, source_guard, recorded_guard, review_closed_originals, export_closed and main bodies.
Eight support helpers against exact R28 exporter V2 and both log parsers against actual R30 V2, byte for byte.
Actual closed R30 launch, environment and preconditions originals; no active test log was read.
R30 producer raw/receipt/complete/incomplete/orchestration-error schemas and original command construction.

findings.detail: FROZEN remains false and all three future closure maps remain None. The require-based FROZEN/__debug__ checks run before any input read or output. The sole subprocess site is the allowlisted Git helper: write-tree, rev-parse, diff, ls-files and ls-tree with --no-optional-locks. No Rust, Cargo metadata, gate, formatter, package installation, apply, reset, process cancellation or remote publication is run.

findings.detail: The exact source53 f74be175de66a4b351cd239d39d98cd34fe9cc1b / 440d4a8e09af4009e4d9ea067388826308da8803 manifest is pinned. All 197 raw source files, SHA256/Git blobs/modes, staged tree, native HEAD bef6fa7645df9df12b69fda499e97eed25de6c75, changed-path set, no untracked/unstaged paths and both raw locks are checked before and after collection. Source50/source51/source52 identities and their historical lock/apply/failure evidence remain distinct.

The exporter compares the actual producer filenames on disk with the bound map. Only a real successful complete record may demand exactly the 19 successful originals. On failure it preserves the actual existing allowed files, raw returns, incomplete and/or orchestration error records, and reports missing successful files without fabricating replacements. The actual R30 producer deliberately gives incomplete.json no schema field; the consumer correctly uses its real fields without inventing a schema requirement.

findings.area: Original return, postprocessing result and outer terminal
findings.detail: Original phase exit comes from the raw process result; effective exit comes separately from the original receipt; outer exit comes only from the natural durable controller terminal. Identity, commands, phase ordering, receipt pointers, resources, raw timings and actual guard records are cross-checked. Nonzero original exits cannot be changed to zero. A missing receipt never permits inferring its result from the controller. Readback errors are retained separately and archive creation success is not promoted to engineering PASS.

clean_lines/review_tests are byte-identical to R30 V2. A full valid log recomputes 1345 exact binary/name identities, counts, reported skips and footer duplicates without filters or invented skip identities. Failed rows retain original byte-offset slices and hashes. If no complete Starting/Summary exists, the parse error is recorded and counts remain null; compilation or incomplete execution is not assigned zero failed tests or a passing population.

findings.area: Actual controller launch and complete output custody
findings.detail: The actual closed launch has /usr/bin/python3 with the single direct-file argument /home/alex/work/hepta-cell-unified-20261106-a/native-run-r30.py, cwd at that task root, pocket4, no env_keys, the exact R30 key and job1a1b25b399f-fc05-7daa, launch.ok true and reused false. These match the exporter. Bound original read ranges must have exact UTF8/hex/offset agreement, contiguous non-overlapping nonempty bytes and terminal stored/seen totals; the two terminal copies must be byte-identical.

Actual R30 environment approved_prerequisite_env_pin contains bytes/SHA256/Git blob and no path. The exporter correctly reads the fixed original agentd-prerequisite-env.json and verifies those pins. Actual preconditions expose all consumed ancestor/apply/provenance keys. The seven-member approved apply input is checked for safe unique regular members, exact full manifest, diagnostic flags, both before/after files and candidate patch; runner and original input archive are also pinned.

Every collected original is read as a stable regular file and reread with the same bytes/mode before export. Derived results use separate names and never replace originals. A create-only gzip/tar preserves raw payloads and original permission bits, with an explicit per-member SHA256/Git blob/size/mode index. The written archive is reopened and every member, mode and payload compared before a create-only fsynced result is published. It remains diagnostic-only and establishes no workspace or scientific qualification.

limitations: This review did not import, execute or simulate the exporter, and did not run any native process or Git command.
Future closure maps remain None in the reviewed template. Exact actual terminal/original/controller bindings and root execution authorization remain required.
The exporter intentionally requires the already-closed R30 startup environment, preconditions and baseline. It is not claimed to export an unrelated failure before those startup prerequisites exist.
A changed current source or unavailable provenance original blocks archive creation; such a guard failure is not silently converted to a partial qualified archive.
The subsequently reported natural R30 result is not independently certified by this static review. Full actual closure/archive readback is a separate step.
Any eventual project PASS applies to this diagnostic source only and does not establish a Bedrock behavior repair, whole-workspace PASS, or scientific authority.
